predecessors.name: Kingdom of Fiji
predecessors.text: the Fijian islands: 'Ratu Seru Epenisa Cakobau had offered to cede the islands'

successors.name: Republic of Fiji
successors.text: 'Fiji became independent on 10 October 1970', with Rotuma 'as part of Fiji'

ledger.x: 1874: Britain takes Fiji (10 October 1874): 'On 10 October 1874, Britain began its rule of Fiji, which lasted until 10 October 1970.'
1877: the seat moves from Levuka to Suva (infobox 'Levuka (1874-1877) Suva (1877-1970)'); the page's text gives 1882.

1881: Rotuma is ceded to Britain and joins the colony: 'On 13 May 1881, Rotuma was officially ceded to the United Kingdom, when the British flag was hoisted by Hugh Romilly'; 'it was governed as part of the Colony of Fiji'.
1970: Fiji becomes independent on 10 October 1970 ('With this compromise, Fiji became independent on 10 October 1970'), a Dominion under the Crown.

certainty.note: An island group: the border is the coast.
